{{Dialogue|Kneesaa|What is this place?|Paploo|There he is, in a reap's nest!|Wicket|Hang on, we'll save you!|Paploo|Hurry, before a reap comes!|attr=In search of Mring-Mring, a team of Ewoks find a reap's nest|src=<ref name="Gupins" />}}
'''Reaps''' were creatures that lived in dead [[Forest/Legends|forests]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. They had a long body, the front end of which featured two [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a beak, with which the reap screeched when attacking foes. The reap also had a dark two-pronged organ located at the back end of their body, from which it extruded elastic, [[Color/Legends|white]]-colored fibre that could entrap members of another [[Species/Legends|species]], such as the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] and [[Gupin/Legends|Gupin]]. Reaps were known to [[Diet/Legends|eat]] Gupins, having completely enveloped the [[Youngling/Legends|young]] Gupin [[Oobel]] in their fibre when they planned to have [[Gender/Legends|him]] for dinner.<ref name="Gupins" />

When the Gupin Mring-Mring went missing, a group of Ewoks consisting of [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa]], [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket]], and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]], stumbled upon a reap's nest as they searched for the lost Gupin. Agitating a group of reaps, Paploo and Wicket were captured by the reaps and taken to their fibre-built nest that [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] Mring-Mring, though Kneesaa and Teebo utilized a fallen [[Tree/Legends|tree]] branch to pull at the reaps' nest, building up force that released their three trapped friends from the reaps' dead forest when they let go of the branch. With their companions freed, Kneesaa and Teebo evaded further attacks from the reaps, quickly making their escape.<ref name="Gupins" />
